tei:div.tei:p: bde chen zhing sgrub kyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so// na mo a mi ta bha ye// nub phyogs bde ldan pad+ma bkod zhing gtso// 'chi med bcom ldan 'od snang mtha' yas la// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob la sogs// byang sems nyan rang dgra bcom 'khor tshogs la// gsol ba= gdod ma'i= sangs rgyas gnyis pa mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung*// rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba= gdod ma'i= mi 'gyur rdo rje bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal// rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma mchog rnams la// gsol ba= gdod ma'i= zhi dang khro bos sprul bsgyur sna tshogs par// ston mdzad yi dam rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba= gdod ma'i= ma mgon lcam dral seng gdong yab yum sogs// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba= gdod ma'i= de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sgrib gnyis nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba rab tu rgyas// 'od dpag med mgon dbyer med sangs rgyas shog /ces gnam chos 'od chog gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs nyung bsdus 'di'ang dge slong karma chos ldan gyis bskul ngor/ 7karma pa bcu bzhi pas gang shar 'phral du bris pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
